homeSendHint: Saved here first; delivery resumes when Home is reachable.
homeStartHint: Send a message to Home. You will see when it is received, running and answered.

qrCameraUnavailable: Camera unavailable. Close other camera apps and try again.
qrCameraUnsupported: Camera scanning is unavailable on this device. Use advanced connection options.

qrCameraBusy: Scanner is already open. Finish or close the current scan.
qrRenderFailed: Could not display the QR code. Close this invitation and create another.

qrHomeUnreachable: Home is unreachable. Check the shared local or private network, then scan again.

qrDecodedConnecting: QR code recognized. Connecting to Home…
qrVerifying: Home received the request. Saving the connection…

qrScanCancelled: Scanning was cancelled. No connection request was sent.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text to copy it.
